initial_observation.encounter_context: presentation related to liver transplantation follow-up
initial_observation.chief_complaint: disseminated skin lesions and pulmonary infiltrates
initial_observation.first_contact_summary: The patient presented with acneiform lesions and erythematous papules, some with ulcerated centers, disseminated on the face, along with signs of pulmonary parenchymal consolidations seen on CT.
presenting_symptoms: erythematous papules with ulcerated centers on the face

evidence_items.source_text: Acneiform lesions and erythematous papules, some with an ulcerated center, disseminated on the face.
inflammatory process detail, showing fungal cells in the giant cell cytoplasm (Hematoxylin & eosin, ×100).
multi-budding fungal cells, characteristic of the Paracoccidioides genus (Grocott-Gomori. Immersion).
CT scan showing peribronchial and perivascular parenchymal consolidations.

hidden_reference.final_diagnosis_verbatim: Disseminated paracoccidioidomycosis in a liver transplant patient
diagnostic_reasoning_verbatim_spans: multi-budding fungal cells, characteristic of the Paracoccidioides genus (Grocott-Gomori. Immersion).
